glossary.definition: (1) "Chronic pain" means pain that has persisted after reasonable medical efforts have been made to relieve the pain or cure its cause and that has continued, either continuously or episodically, for longer than three continuous months. "Chronic pain" does not include pain associated with a terminal condition or with a progressive disease that, in the normal course of progression, may reasonably be expected to result in a terminal condition.
glossary.source_title: Section 4731.052 - Administrative rules for management of chronic pain with controlled substances.

glossary.definition: (2) "Controlled substance" has the same meaning as in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code.
